uploadHint: Drop an image here, choose a file, or paste from your clipboard.
formatsHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, and other browser-supported images. Animated images export as a still frame.
noSelection: Choose Select & move to edit a region, or choose a shape to draw.
drawHint: Drag on the image to cover an area.
brushHint: Paint over the area you want to hide.
selectHint: Select a region, then drag to move. Use its corner to resize and the top handle to rotate.
panHint: Drag to move around the image.
canvasKeyboardHint: Enter adds a region. [ and ] select regions. Arrow keys move the selection.
privacyTip: Use solid color for sensitive text; blur and pixelation can leave details visible.
exportHint: Exports keep the original image dimensions.
imageError: This image could not be opened. Try a PNG, JPEG, or WebP file.
exportError: The image could not be exported. Please try again.
copyError: Clipboard access is unavailable. Download the image instead.
shortcuts: V Select · H Pan · R Rectangle · E Ellipse · B Brush · Enter Add · [ / ] Select region · Delete Remove · Ctrl/⌘ Z Undo · Shift Ctrl/⌘ Z Redo · Arrows Move (Shift ×10).
